verdict.rationale: Discord provides a well-documented official REST API, OAuth2 authentication, Gateway WebSocket API, webhooks, and an Embedded App SDK for building bots/automated integrations, which are the building blocks an AI-native developer would use. Live probes confirm the REST/Gateway endpoints are functional and docs are machine-readable (llms.txt), though there's no dedicated 'AI agent' SDK—developers use the same general bot/OAuth2 APIs as any integration.
